heroHeadline: Junta Jet Bombs Kyauktaw Market, Killing 33+ Civilians in Rakhine — Day 2,065
heroSubtitle: On September 28, 2026, a junta fighter jet dropped two bombs near the main wholesale market in Kyauktaw, Rakhine State, killing at least 33 people and wounding 36, according to the Arakan Army and a rescue official — among the deadliest airstrikes in Rakhine since December 2025. The Arakan Army separately reported 6 civilians killed and 16 injured in airstrikes across nine townships between September 17 and 27, while fighting continues along the Sittwe-Ponnagyun border and in Laymyethna, Ayeyarwady, against the junta's 'Operation 4926'.
